title: standardize-rate-limit-idempotency-retry-after-streaming-openai-compat-tool-calls
author: Maya Patel
ci_status: pass (one flaky test failed on first run; rerun passed)
description: Motivation: Streaming endpoints, function/tool calling paths, and our OpenAI compatibility layer were emitting inconsistent rate-limit headers and error-body semantics which made client retry logic and idempotency handling brittle. This PR unifies rate-limit header semantics (X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, Retry-After) across normal and streaming endpoints, introduces explicit idempotency-key handling for function/tool-calling flow with clear retry-after semantics, and standardizes error codes/messages exposed by the OpenAI-compat layer so third-party clients can rely on consistent behavior. Changes include runtime throttling plumbing, API layer middleware, compatibility translations, tests, and documentation updates. Checklist: - [x] Implement rate-limit header propagation for streaming (server and proxy) - [x] Add Retry-After semantics for capacity throttles and transient backpressure - [x] Enforce and document idempotency-key behavior for tool/function calls (at-most-once semantics for retriable errors) - [x] Map internal error class -> OpenAI-compat error code consistently - [x] Add unit + integration tests including simulated partial-stream disconnects - [x] Update OpenAI-compat docs and changelog Links: Linear ENG-1482 (rate-limit consistency), ENG-1507 (idempotency for tool calls), internal incident SUP-3321 that motivated stricter Retry-After handling. Notes: The description below contains implementation notes, developer guidance, and upgrade considerations.

testing_summary: Unit tests added for ratelimit header propagation and idempotency store semantics. Integration tests simulate backpressure and partial-stream disconnects to confirm Retry-After flows to clients. CI initially failed due to timing flake in streaming test; test harness updated and rerun succeeded. Load test verified no measurable latency regression under normal load; throttle paths correctly emit Retry-After header and 429 bodies.
release_notes: Standardizes rate-limit headers and Retry-After semantics across streaming and OpenAI-compat endpoints; introduces documented idempotency behavior for function/tool calls to enable safe client retries; mapping of internal errors to OpenAI-compatible error codes made consistent.
upgrade_notes: Operators: no migration necessary. Users: clients should prefer Retry-After header for backoff. For function/tool-calling workflows, include an Idempotency-Key header to ensure at-most-once semantics across retries; see documented TTL (default 24h) and semantics in docs/openai-compat.md.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: clients that relied on previous inconsistent header behavior might mis-handle retries. Mitigation: we backfilled OpenAI-compat docs, added logging to detect clients receiving unexpected status, and the change is feature-flagged for Dedicated customers for a 2-week ramp.
notes_for_release_manager: Include note in weekly changelog about idempotency-key recommendation and the default TTL. Coordinate with Dedicated rollout to toggle feature flag after 2026-03-01.
automation_summary: Added CI job ratelimit_integration to run in staging; test harness includes a flaky-tolerant retry wrapper. Added linter suppression for tight coupling warnings in idempotency store tests.
